description:
HushMessenger v0.0.4 is a preview Morphe patch source for Messenger 580.0.0.49.91 (arm64, version code 346013387).

**[Download the patch bundle](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/releases/download/v0.0.4/patches-0.0.4.mpp)** | [Check its SHA-256](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/releases/download/v0.0.4/SHA256SUMS.txt)

The `.mpp` file is a patch bundle. Bring your own unmodified Messenger APK. Signed-in phone behavior is unverified, so use a test session and plan a backup before replacing an installed app.

## What changed

- The README now puts the exact APK and data-safety checks before setup.
- Patch errors name the supported build and tell you to retry with an unmodified APK.
- The patch and source descriptions are shorter. Ten unit tests pass.

## Checks

Morphe Desktop 1.17.0 patched a copy of the stock APK off-device. The rebuild and signing steps succeeded, and Android verified its v3 signature. The manifest has 29 renamed permission mentions and no old names. The modified DEX has six active renamed loads and no active old loads in those classes.

A clean Morphe Manager 1.32.0 profile on an isolated Android emulator imported both the remote source and local `.mpp`, then listed the patch for Messenger build 346013387. Morphe Desktop fetched the published bundle, and its checksum matched the local build. The installed S22 app was untouched. Login, encrypted chats, calls and notifications still need a signed-in arm64 device check.

In Manager, turn on **Pre-release patches** on the HushMessenger remote source card for later preview updates. Local `.mpp` sources need manual updates. Use one source method to avoid duplicate HushMessenger cards, and keep your signing key for later patched app updates.

```text
dbd0dbee2359c5225b8c6fecf11699d0255ee2b8b0048b5d40a80c62f4ff42d6  patches-0.0.4.mpp
```
